title: Mutant Melee Whomper
description: Mutant Melee Whomper — The Townstons wiki
html:
[GG] Whomper


The Melee Whomper looks very similar to the Mutant Ranged Spitter but has an entirely different attack. Whompers are created to bash! Armed with a huge pneumatic hammer they stand still and just pound. A group of them will try to surround you, and then use their back hammer with devastating effect. They are sometimes found in company with types of ranged fades to make up a difficult group to fight.

Race: Mutant

Class: Fighter

Basic Types

Name Element Habitat
[GG] Whomper Ice Haxhaxor Libratorium and Good Griefers Climate-Controlled Gymnasium off Shadow's Embrace
Frosty Melee Spitter Ice Balzack's Burrow level 4
Mutant Melee Spitter Poison The Nether Crypts off Balzack's Burrow

Tip: Because they close in for their attack they are vulnerable to AoE spells.
